title: The Carnegie Planet Finder Spectrograph a status report
what_was_studied: Mechanical layout, Nasmyth mounting, enclosure and iodine-cell spectrograph subsystems
numerical_result: The pre-commissioning instrument was designed for the 6.5 m Magellan Clay telescope and high-resolution iodine-cell velocities
remaining_question: Construction status and design expectations do not establish on-sky precision

title: The Carnegie Planet Finder Spectrograph integration and commissioning
what_was_studied: Integration, initial five-month standard-star sequence and early instrument configuration
numerical_result: The commissioning report states better than 1 m/s RMS on selected standard stars during the first five months
remaining_question: The instrument was later reconfigured, so the result needs an era label and cannot describe all subsequent data

title: The Magellan PFS Planet Search Program radial velocities of HD 133131 A and B
what_was_studied: Five- to six-year PFS and MIKE time series used for a multi-planet analysis
numerical_result: PFS supplied a five-year velocity baseline for HD 133131 B and contributed to the first planets reported primarily from PFS data
remaining_question: Planet-model residuals and heterogeneous multi-instrument baselines are not an instrument-only stability test

title: VELOcities of CEpheids Data Release 1
what_was_studied: Large long-baseline radial-velocity release using multiple instruments including PFS
numerical_result: The release contains 18225 velocities for 258 confirmed Cepheids, with observations spanning 2010 to 2022
remaining_question: Cepheid variability at tens to hundreds of m/s addresses a different accuracy regime from exoplanet EPRV work

title: Earth and Planets Laboratory instrumentation roster
what_was_studied: Current institutional description and access model for PFS
numerical_result: The roster describes PFS as a current PI instrument on Magellan and states velocity precision better than 1 m/s
remaining_question: The page does not define the sample, baseline, reduction version or latest hardware configuration behind that broad statement

title: Las Campanas technical documentation instrument list
numerical_result: The facility documentation lists PFS under Magellan instruments
remaining_question: The roster confirms presence but does not by itself provide a dated performance characterization
